I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.

I can only put down a tegust that I am astleying.

I can only stack a tegust robiess over another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is bluenible.
Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes gineurate.
Once you stack a tegust robiess over a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer bluenible.
